notes: Six evals over the capabilities restored after commit 4f0ca73: impact analysis, Manual-test conversion, --related coverage, and deferred automation. Assertions are graded by evals/grade.py where they are mechanical, and by a reviewer where they are not.

evals.name: constraint-outside-the-ac-table
evals.prompt: Run the QA review for MOM-12194. The artifact folder is already at docs/qa/MOM-12194/ with ticket.md, test-design.md, the feature file, and the Xray exports. Tell me whether this design is ready to hand to automation.
evals.expected_output: QA review reports the Out-Scope prohibition ('Do not allow user/system modify any candidate has attached to APM's invoice') as an uncovered testable constraint at Critical or Important severity, and routes back to design instead of passing.
assertions: The review names the prohibition on modifying a candidate attached to an APM invoice
That finding is classified Critical or Important, not Minor
review.status is set to changes-requested and resume_target routes back to design
The review does not report the design as fully covering the ticket

evals.name: constraint-under-a-neutral-heading
evals.prompt: Review the QA design for the charge settlement story in docs/qa/MOM-12480/. Is anything from the ticket left uncovered?
evals.expected_output: The review finds the settlement re-rate prohibition filed under Notes, proving the check reads the whole ticket rather than a heading named Out-Scope. The eight-row AC table is complete, so a reviewer reading only the table finds nothing.
assertions: The review names the prohibition on re-rating or re-assigning a settled charge
The finding is raised even though every acceptance-criteria row is already covered
The review does not claim the design is complete because the AC table is complete

evals.name: impact-invariant-on-an-unnamed-flow
evals.prompt: Design the QA coverage for MOM-12194. The impact sweep has already run and its candidates are in docs/qa/MOM-12194/impact-candidates.md.
evals.expected_output: Design produces a scenario for the refresh invariant (an invoice-attached candidate must survive RefreshWorkOrderCandidates), and every other impact candidate is either covered by a scenario or recorded in impact.dropped_scenarios with a reason.
assertions: A scenario covers the RefreshWorkOrderCandidates invariant
Every entry in impact.candidates is named in approved_scenarios or dropped_scenarios
Each dropped candidate carries a non-empty reason
validate-run-state.py exits 0 on the resulting run.json
No impact candidate is marked as affected or high-risk in the artifacts; candidates stay evidence

evals.name: dedup-against-related-issue-coverage
evals.prompt: Design QA coverage for MOM-12500 and dedup it. Related stories MOM-12401 and MOM-12408 already have Xray coverage in the same flow; their exports are in the artifact folder.
evals.expected_output: The scenario that already exists in the MOM-12401 export is labeled SKIP, not NEW, and test-design.md names the file the match came from.
assertions: The scenario already covered by MOM-12401 is labeled SKIP or REVIEW, never NEW
test-design.md names existing-tests-MOM-12401.feature as the file the match came from
The audit-trail behaviour, which exists only in the manual export, is labeled REVIEW and cites MOM-3042, rather than being reported as uncovered
Every existing-tests-<KEY>.feature is passed to the dedup script, not only existing-tests.feature
An all-NEW script result is not reported as evidence that the story has no existing coverage
coverage.dedup records that dedup ran

evals.name: manual-conversion-fidelity
evals.prompt: The team wants MOM-3110, an existing Xray Manual test, converted to Gherkin so it can be automated. Its export is in docs/qa/MOM-12550/existing-tests-manual.md. Convert it.
evals.expected_output: The conversion links rather than overwrites, declares every deviation, and refuses to invent an assertion for the unmechanizable step.
assertions: No converted scenario carries a @TEST_ tag
conversion.converted[].mode is link
conversion.converted[].manual_test records MOM-3110
The vague verification step becomes a manual-surface scenario or an explicit question, never an invented assertion
Splitting the one manual case into several scenarios is reported as a deviation
The original manual steps are presented beside the Gherkin for the human to compare

evals.name: design-ready-before-code
evals.prompt: The story MOM-12600 is specced but the implementation is not merged yet. I want the test cases written and reviewed now, and automation later. Run speckit-qa-auto --issue MOM-12600 --design-only.
evals.expected_output: The run finishes with reviewed QA artifacts and automation.status: deferred, carrying a reason and a checkable resume_when. It does not write automation-result.json and does not report automation as blocked.
assertions: automation.status is deferred, not blocked or not-run
automation.deferred.reason and automation.deferred.resume_when are both non-empty
resume_when names something a person can check later, not 'when the code is done'
No automation-result.json is written
validate-run-state.py exits 0 on the resulting run.json
The finish report states the deferral as the next action rather than as a coverage gap
